definitions.gloss: Gospel; one of the four Gospels
definitions.explanation: Any of the four New Testament books — Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John — that recount the life and teachings of Jesus Christ.

examples.japanese: {福音書|ふくいんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。

examples.english: I like the Gospel of Matthew.

notes:
Refers to the four canonical Gospels of the New Testament. ⟦{福音|ふくいん}→福音：27100_fukuin⟧ means 'good news,' and ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ means 'book; writing.'

- マタイ⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{福音書|ふくいんしょ}: the Gospel of Matthew
- {四福音書|よんふくいんしょ}: the four Gospels
